name: Volunteer hours
summary: Reach a volunteer hours target with a monthly schedule at the places you choose.

plan_blueprint.calendar: Volunteer shifts on the chosen slots and a monthly hours check. Phase length follows the months you chose.

approach_variants.habit: Same shift on the same day each week; streak of weeks served.
approach_variants.willpower: Monthly hours challenge and a countdown to the hours target.
approach_variants.time: Shifts and travel time are calendar blocks; monthly hours review.
approach_variants.reward: Reflection and an owner-chosen treat at each quarter of the target.
approach_variants.resource: First weeks handle sign-up, training, background checks and transport.

guardrails: Follow the organisation's safety rules and training.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
restart_rules: Missed hours spread across the remaining months.
